elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 11 requires only the care, skill, and prudence TrueLink customarily exercises for its own operations; it does not impose a professional-and-workmanlike standard.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants that the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty applies for 12 months following delivery.
The Hosting Services and Support Services conformance warranty applies for 90 days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy expressly includes repair or replacement of non-conforming software and re-performance of non-conforming Services.
The remedy expressly includes a refund of fees paid for non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No warranty concerning malicious code appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and related software are warranted to conform to documentation for 12 months, exceeding 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted to conform to the Agreement for 90 days, exceeding 30 days.
